goalTextEn: Can talk about yourself using simple self-introduction phrases.
goalTextKr: 간단한 자기소개 표현을 사용하여 자기 자신에 대해 이야기할 수 있다.

introduce.goalEn: Can talk about yourself using simple self-introduction phrases.
introduce.goalKr: 간단한 자기소개 표현을 사용하여 자기 자신에 대해 이야기할 수 있다.
introduce.situationEn: It's your first time meeting your teammates at a new company. Everyone is taking turns introducing themselves. Now it's your turn!
introduce.situationKr: 새 회사에서 팀원들을 처음 만납니다. 모두가 차례대로 자기소개를 하고 있습니다. 당신 차례입니다!

tutorNotes.text: "Today, we'll practice talking about yourself. You'll introduce yourself like you're meeting new teammates."
Read the lesson goal aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
"Is it clear?"
Read the situation. Check the student understands.
"Let's go to the next part."
Encourage the student that mistakes are OK. The goal is to practice speaking.

vocabulary.definition: a section of a company (e.g., sales, marketing)
a group of people who work together
to tell someone your name and information about yourself

pronunciation.instruction: Let's practice hearing the difference between /l/ and /r/.

tutorNotes.text: "Let's look at useful phrases for introducing yourself."
Read each pattern aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
Explain the vocabulary words.
"Now let's practice pronunciation."
For Japanese learners, /l/ and /r/ are often confused. Practice slowly.
Demonstrate tongue position: /l/ = tongue touches roof of mouth, /r/ = tongue curls back.

understand.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct pattern. Then practice the pattern drills.
understand.instructionKr: 빈칸에 올바른 패턴을 넣으세요. 그런 다음 패턴 드릴을 연습하세요.

tutorNotes.text: Ask the student to fill in the blanks, then practice the pattern drills.
If a student struggles, give them the first letter as a hint.

steps.title: Step 1 — Repeat After Me
steps.instructionEn: Listen and repeat each self-introduction sentence.
steps.content:
1. Hi, I'm Yuki.
2. I work at Global Corp.
3. I'm in the marketing department.
4. I am from Sapporo.
5. I like traveling.
6. Nice to meet you!

tutorNotes.text: Read each sentence slowly. Have the student repeat.
Correct pronunciation gently. Focus on natural rhythm.
Model natural intonation — don't read in a flat tone.

steps.title: Step 2 — Fill in Your Introduction
steps.instructionEn: Complete these sentences with your own information.

tutorNotes.text: Ask the student to fill in each blank with their real info.
After filling in, have them read the full introduction aloud.
If the student doesn't work at a company, they can say 'I study at...' or 'I work at home.'

steps.title: Step 3 — Dialogue Practice
steps.instructionEn: Practice the dialogue with your tutor. You are the new team member.
steps.instructionKr: 선생님과 대화를 연습하세요. 당신은 새로운 팀원입니다.

dialogue.en: Hi! Welcome to the team. I'm Naomi.
dialogue.kr: 안녕하세요! 팀에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 저는 나오미입니다.

dialogue.en: Hi, I'm (your name). Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?
What do you like to do in your free time?
dialogue.kr: 자유 시간에 뭘 하는 걸 좋아하세요?

tutorNotes.text: Read the tutor lines. The student fills in their own info for the student lines.
Do it once reading, then once without looking at the screen.
If time permits, switch roles so the student practices asking questions too.

steps.title: Step 4 — Free Introduction
steps.instructionEn: Introduce yourself to your tutor without looking at any notes. Try to say at least 5 sentences.
steps.instructionKr: 메모를 보지 않고 선생님에게 자기소개를 하세요. 5문장 이상 말해 보세요.
steps.content:
Include:
- Your name
- Where you're from
- Where you work / what you do
- Your department
- Something you like / your hobby

tutorNotes.text: "OK, now it's your turn! Introduce yourself to me. Don't look at your notes!"
Let the student speak freely. Note any errors but don't interrupt.
After they finish, give feedback on pronunciation and grammar.
If the student stops after 2-3 sentences, prompt: 'What else? Where are you from?'

challenge.scenarioEn: You joined a new project team. Introduce yourself to three new teammates. Your tutor will play each teammate and ask you questions.
challenge.scenarioKr: 새로운 프로젝트 팀에 합류했습니다. 3명의 새 팀원에게 자기소개를 하세요. 선생님이 각 팀원 역할을 하며 질문합니다.

guideQuestions.text: Tell them about your job / department.

tutorNotes.text: "Time for the challenge! I'll be three different teammates. Introduce yourself to each one."
Play Teammate 1 (friendly): 'Hi! I'm Alex. What's your name?'
Play Teammate 2 (curious): 'Hey there! Welcome! So, where are you from?'
Play Teammate 3 (casual): 'Nice to meet you! What department are you in?'
Grade: If the student can introduce themselves smoothly all 3 times, they've achieved the goal.

discussion.instructionEn: Choose one category, then answer the questions.

categories.title: FIRST DAY AT WORK
questions: What did you say on your first day?
Who was the first person you met?

categories.title: YOUR IDEAL INTRODUCTION
questions: What information do you always include?
Do you prefer short or long introductions?

categories.title: MEETING NEW PEOPLE
questions: Do you like meeting new people?
What's a good way to start a conversation?
What questions do you ask new people?

tutorNotes.text: "Now let's have a discussion."
Ask the student to choose a category. Discuss for 3-5 minutes.
Encourage the student to use the patterns learned today in their answers.

feedback.goalReviewEn: Can talk about yourself using simple self-introduction phrases.
feedback.goalReviewKr: 간단한 자기소개 표현을 사용하여 자기 자신에 대해 이야기할 수 있다.

tutorNotes.text: "Great work today! It's the end of the lesson."
Ask the student to read the lesson goal.
"Were you able to achieve today's lesson goal?"
Fill in and send the feedback template via chat.
Practice mispronounced words with the student.
Encourage the next lesson: 'Next time, you'll learn to introduce your teammates!'
